status: Registered before reduced-model training or inspection of reduced final predictions
scope: Retrospective additional evaluation; no feature reselection; no claim of a blind test

selection_roles.C_top5: primary frozen fixed list, distinct from development adaptive policy
selection_roles.C_spatial: frozen sensitivity; never retrospectively promoted to primary

population: y_ENE_02.notna() & sp_wind.notna(), unchanged for every training and evaluation representation

reduced_training.unknown_categories: unchanged OrdinalEncoder unknown_value NaN, including month and region_month
reduced_training.repeat_determinism: repeat both reduced April fits once; preserve primary runs only

thresholds.A_B: Preserve final_predictions.parquet thresholds; independently reconstruct with selected_oof quad F3 plus previous monthly historical predictions and original available_history/decision_threshold
thresholds.reduced_warm_start: Own monthly OOF predictions from frozen 2B-1, already available before April; no new pre-April models and no retroactive fixed-list refits
thresholds.reduced_April: Verify original rule reproduces frozen C_top5=.24 and C_spatial=.21; use those values
thresholds.updates: Original available_history: [cutoff(O)-90 days, cutoff(O)); original decision_threshold: max F1 on .01 to .99 grid, smallest tie; fallback .5 if n<100 or no positives; append only previous external-origin predictions
thresholds.conflict_resolution: Current explicit user instruction to preserve historical A/B thresholds takes precedence over 2B-1 suggested new A/B warm starts (.28/.22). No frozen file is edited. Reduced warm starts and feature lists stay exactly frozen.
thresholds.comparability_caveat: A/B start from historical F3 and reduced systems from new monthly OOF. C_top5 initial history used adaptive development subsets, while evaluation uses a fixed list. Alert comparisons include these initialization differences; probability metrics do not depend on thresholds.

bootstrap.routine: Original WeightedAP exact weighted AP including ties; same multinomial nonoverlapping calendar-block method as 2B-1, strict population equality before alignment
bootstrap.boundaries: From April 1 00:00 to October 1 00:00 local; final incomplete block retained; calendar never compressed; all regions/models share block multiplicities; empty blocks retained
bootstrap.nominal_intervals: percentiles .025 and .975, absolute AP/Brier/F1 and paired differences; all estimates from pooled observations, not mean monthly scores
bootstrap.simultaneous_lower_AP: For the two reduced-minus-B contrasts, per block size: q=.975 quantile of max_j((delta*_j-delta_j)/sd_j), L_j=delta_j-q*sd_j; approximate bootstrap maxT. No simultaneous claim for other contrasts or Brier. sd=0 gives standardized error zero.
bootstrap.scope: Conditional on fitted models and frozen configuration; no refitting/reselection inside resamples; six dependent months and few long blocks limit coverage claims

noninferiority.qualification: Both nominal and simultaneous lower AP limits strictly greater than -.01 for both 168 and 672 h
noninferiority.interpretation: Operational sensitivity convention, not universal scientific margin or equivalence proof
noninferiority.Brier: Report signed differences and nominal intervals without post-hoc acceptance margin

descriptive_analysis: Monthly, regional, and month-by-region metrics; prevalence associations descriptive only, no independent-replicate tests or outcome-based feature changes
figures: AP versus meteorological count with effective-entry labels
five paired AP contrasts with both block sizes, primary simultaneous lower limits and NI margin
